newsitem.title: GREECE: BASKETBALL-AMERICAN PLAYER CHARGED AFTER FIGHT.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-AMERICAN PLAYER CHARGED AFTER FIGHT.

text.p: American forward Gary Alexander was charged with assault on Thursday after brawling players forced the abandonment of a Korac Cup basketball match between his Turkish team Besiktas and Greek rivals Aris.
Police said they arrested Alexander at his hotel hours before his team were due to return home after a suit was filed by Aris forward Dinos Angelidis. He was later released on bail.

Television pictures showed Alexander hitting Angelidis from behind and then grabbing him and throwing him off the court during Wednesday's game. Other players joined in the fighting and police had to separate them..
Besiktas had demanded that a banner hoisted by Greek fans, reading "Greece's capital is Constantinople" was removed, but referees and officials said they had no juristiction outside the court.
Most Greeks refer to the modern Turkish city of Istanbul as Constantinople, the city's Byzantine name.
Aris officials said the banner was in response to one shown by Turkish fans in the first leg in Istanbul which said "Cyprus is Turkish".
Greece and Turkey have long been at odds over several issues, including the divided island of Cyprus, rights in the Aegean Sea and minority rights in both countries.
